item.title: ToxicPanda 2.0 and GoldDigger Expand Android Banking Attacks with On-Device Fraud
item.description: Cybersecurity researchers have shed light on an updated version of ToxicPanda (aka TgToxic) that comes with "significant enhancements," including a set of 167 remote commands and expands its targeting footprint globally. Zimperium zLabs, in a Wednesday report, said the Android malware also features a PIN harvesting workflow targeting more than 140 banking and cryptocurrency applications.

item.title: Phishing 3.0: The Fight Moves to Agent Versus Agent
item.description: Most email defenses still do the job they did a decade ago. Scan the message, look for something malicious, block it. It stopped working when the danger moved into the message's intent, and it is failing now that the sender is no longer a person.
